__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He's lived a life of violence ever since he was little.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A member of the Trolls wanders about here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: troll gang member

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He wants to rid the world of every last Troll gang member.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A member of the Ogres wanders about here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: ogre gang member

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
He's risen to be leader through brute force and cunning leadership, you'd
guess mostly brute force from the size of his muscles.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The gang leader is not pleased you found his hideout!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: gang leader troll

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He's 6'6" 245 pounds and enough muscle to bash your head in. How like a Troll.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A big, mean bruiser is looking for limbs to break.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: bruiser troll

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: She's a beauty (ok in RELATIVE terms) but you better not touch!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A gang doll looks naughty and nice.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: gang doll

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He'd rather be at the local pub then out here with these nasty kids.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A patrolman is trying to keep the peace.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: patrolman patrol man

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He has a wary eye and a fine hand for art.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A vandal is spray painting pro-gang slogans on the wall here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: vandal ogre

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
You get a nice close look at him while he's tearing at your throat.
His fangs are blood-stained from hearty meals of ... steak?!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A vicious pitbull is foaming at the mouth in rabid anticipation.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: dog pit bull pitbull

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He's a sterling example of rehabilitation at work.  Not nice.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A punk is here, carving his initials into a wall.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: punk troll

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He's smaller, but undoubtably smarter, than the Troll's leader.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The Ogre gang leader snaps out his stiletto. "Care to dance?"
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: gang leader ogre

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The thug isn't quite as big as the Troll's bruisers, but you can tell he loves
breaking heads for the Ogres.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: An ugly, scarred thug is here, looking for dogs to kick.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: thug
